scope: Explicit reviewed implementation dispositions and scoped qualification; accepted ownership subsets do not confer full rendering/service parity.

SURVEY.Standard-primitives-linksets.implementation_note: R1 host-qualified object/link/face ownership, parent retirement and lifecycle are implemented and production-replay qualified. Complete primitive LOD, rendering classification and visual variants remain R2/R4 requirements.

SURVEY.Mesh-assets-LOD.implementation_note: R1 bounded mesh decode/cache/retry/replacement, mainloop ownership, crossing reuse and CPU/GPU payload retirement are implemented and software qualified through production HTTP/message replay and renderer readbacks. Full geometry/texture/local-editing/material producer parity remains R2/R3/R9. See doc/vulkan/r1-owner-lifecycle.md.

SURVEY.Self-other-system-avatars.implementation_note: R1 typed CPU avatar ownership, early self initialization, wearable metadata and self-owner continuity with safe destination-ground rebinding are implemented and production-replay qualified. Complete appearance/COF, locomotion, cloth and shader/view variants remain R2.

SURVEY.Rigged-attachments-animesh.implementation_note: R1 attachment/control-avatar identities and control animation metadata are implemented; control owners do not create a human body substitute. Weighted attachment palette skinning exists, while full fitted/HUD/joint-override and independent animesh production remain R2.

SURVEY.Terrain.implementation_note: R1 sparse bounded L/M terrain, neighbour ownership and variable-region dimensions are implemented and production-replay qualified. Four-way/PBR splatting, geometry LOD and complete terrain/environment rendering remain R2/R3/R5.

SURVEY.Analytic-atmosphere-sky-sun-moon-.implementation_note: Procedural gradient exists; it does not implement the analytic EEP atmosphere, celestial bodies, clouds or stars.

SURVEY.Water-void-water-haze-exclusion.implementation_note: Flat alpha surface at region water height; reference water/environment/depth/reflection behavior remains open.

SURVEY.Visibility-G-buffer.implementation_note: Bounded scene visibility and simple depth exist; native deferred G-buffer and full spatial/occlusion ownership remain open.

SURVEY.Sun-moon-local-projector-lights.implementation_note: Fixed sun/ambient shader inputs only; complete EEP, local/projector and BRDF lighting remains open.

SURVEY.Alpha-masks-PPLL.implementation_note: Fixed mask threshold and sorted straight alpha exist; full classifications, water ordering, PPLL and residual paths remain open.

SURVEY.Voice-and-spatial-services.implementation_note: Shared client initialization is present; native provisioning/region/spatial lifecycle still requires integration.

SURVEY.Firestorm-bridge.implementation_note: Account retirement is guarded, but native attachment/task inventory/script ownership and handshake are incomplete.

FEATURE.Startup.implementation_note: R1 actual startup/settings/account/CPU-worker/authentication/circuit/capability/inventory/appearance-owner sequencing, real progress events, failures/retry/cancellation and shutdown are production-replay qualified.
FEATURE.Startup.remaining_gap: Platform CI and authenticated public-grid qualification are separate. Full login/logout progress presentation belongs to R9, persistent texture-cache parity to R3 and complete COF/wearable production to R2.

FEATURE.PersistentTextureCache.implementation_note: Native CPU HTTP/decode and in-memory images do not establish LLTextureCache disk read/write subscriber parity.

FEATURE.BuiltinAO.implementation_note: Shared AO engine exists but its legacy self-avatar animation ownership is not established by the native CPU avatar owner.
